meta.note: Merged from the Mikado system (structure, status semantics, type scale, spacing), the Tern system (chrome, agents, console, pipeline) and the Tern v2 mockups on the Nocturne theme (dark ground, blurple accent, outlined actions, running glow).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and canvas ground. Dark is the Tern v2 (Nocturne) ground. Light is the same blue-grey family, toned down one step so the page is not bright.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Panels, the left rail, the sidecar, cards, graph nodes, hover cards, inputs. Light is off-white, not pure white.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Console wells, meter tracks, alternate rows, the graph canvas inset.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: panel dividers, card borders, row rules. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders, dependency edges, pending node strokes; 3:1 on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on every surface: titles, node titles, values, console text.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text on any surface: metadata, agent sub-lines, kickers, timestamps, status words.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Tertiary text and placeholders on surface-raised only (4.99:1 light, 5.25:1 dark). Use sparingly.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Blurple, from Tern v2. The one brand colour: outlined primary buttons' borders, selection, the focus ring, running strokes and glows, the coordinator dot. In light it also serves as text; in dark it is 4.7:1 on surface-raised, so text under 24px uses accent-text instead.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Selected row, done-node ground, accent chips and 'you' chat bubbles; accent text on it.

tokens.name: accent-strong
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent controls and the bright end of a progress fill.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: The accent as running text under 24px: console results, gate passes, links, the right-hand figure in agent rows, badge and button labels. In dark it lifts to the v2 accent-300 (10:1 on surface-raised) because the accent itself is only 4.7:1 there; in light it is the accent. Strokes, dots, rings and glows keep using accent.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a solid accent fill (rare: the today line label, a filled meter cap).

tokens.name: running
tokens.usage: Status: an agent or node actively working. Alias of accent, so activity and brand always agree. Paired with the half-circle glyph and, on nodes, the pulse glow.

tokens.name: done
tokens.usage: Status: complete. Deliberately neutral so finished work recedes; always with the check glyph. Same value as ink-muted, kept separate so they can diverge.

tokens.name: done-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of done badges and completed nodes. Light is one visible step below surface-sunken so a done node still reads on the canvas.

tokens.name: at-risk
tokens.usage: Status: at risk — a failed gate, a stuck iteration, context over 80%. Always with the triangle glyph. As text on surfaces or at-risk-soft.

tokens.name: at-risk-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of at-risk badges and failed nodes.

tokens.name: blocked
tokens.usage: Status: blocked by an unfinished prerequisite; also the critical path. Always with the circle-slash glyph. As text on surfaces or blocked-soft.

tokens.name: blocked-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of blocked badges and blocked nodes.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Critical-path edges and node outlines: an alias of blocked so the two always agree.

tokens.name: series-neutral
tokens.usage: Default fill for bars, meters and flavor chips when nothing is grouped. Colour is opt-in.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Workstream / flavor colour 1 (teal), Paul Tol muted, adjusted to clear 3:1. Fills only, applied in order; labels sit beside in ink. The order keeps neighbours apart under every common colour-vision deficiency and keeps indigo, the accent's near-twin in dark, last.

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Workstream / flavor colour 2 (wine).

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Workstream / flavor colour 3 (sky).

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Workstream / flavor colour 4 (rose).

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Workstream / flavor colour 5 (olive). Reads close to at-risk under red–green deficiency: never place it beside an at-risk badge.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Workstream / flavor colour 6 (indigo). In dark it is within ΔE 2 of the accent, so it is last and only reached with six groups; beyond six, group rather than add hues.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: The goal's name as a page title. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The goal node, sidecar and dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and section headings, the agent detail header. Medium weight, never bold: hierarchy is size and space.

styles.name: stat
styles.usage: The large figure in a stats tile or the stats dialog. Put its unit in caption beside it.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Queued prompts reach the worker on its next poll.
styles.usage: Default reading text: briefs, chat, notes, review findings.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Node titles, agent names, buttons, rail items. The workhorse.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata lines under names, rail counts, toasts' time. Always ink-muted or ink.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Uppercase section kickers in the rail and panels: ink-muted for regions, accent only for the region that is live.

styles.name: wordmark
styles.usage: The wordmark in the rail header, uppercase, beside the accent ring.

styles.name: stat-small
styles.usage: The figure in the rail footer, over a caption in ink-muted.

styles.name: console
styles.usage: Console and gate lines; the timestamp column in ink-muted.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: IDs, paths, token counts, durations and costs wherever columns must align.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Glyph-to-text gap, chip padding, rail row gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside controls; between node lines; rail row padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Node, hover-card and rail padding; console padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and sidecar padding; gap between sibling nodes.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panel sections; between graph levels.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page margins, between major regions.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, chips, meters, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, nodes, rail rows, hover cards, toasts.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The graph canvas, the sidecar, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pill-style nodes and status dots only.

size.note: Fixed chrome sizes from the Tern v2 layout and Mikado's density.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: The left rail: wordmark, actions, agents, reviews, project.

tokens.name: sidecar-width
tokens.usage: The right sidecar for node detail, agent or review; 560px when it holds a review.

tokens.name: dock-height
tokens.usage: The coordinator dock when open above its input bar.

tokens.name: node-width
tokens.usage: Card-style graph node; titles wrap to two lines then truncate.

tokens.name: row-height
tokens.usage: Rail rows, agent rows, table rows.

tokens.name: hovercard-width
tokens.usage: Maximum hover-card width.

tokens.name: dot
tokens.usage: Status dot; 10px in the agent header, 6px in kickers.

tokens.name: sidecar-width-review
tokens.usage: The sidecar when it shows a review with its annotation card.

tokens.name: dialog-width
tokens.usage: A confirm or edit dialog.

tokens.name: dialog-width-wide
tokens.usage: The stats dialog and a popped-out review.

tokens.name: toast-width
tokens.usage: A toast in the bottom-right stack.

tokens.name: canvas-min-width
tokens.usage: The smallest viewport the one-screen layout supports. Below it, the page scrolls sideways.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Icon buttons and the segmented control on the canvas toolbar.

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Hover cards, menus, toasts and dialogs only. Everything else is flat with hairlines.

tokens.name: shadow-glow-running
tokens.usage: The halo on a running node or the live coordinator dot: the accent as light, never as a fill. Pulses out to 10px and fades (1.8s).

opacity.note: Alpha steps for tints and edges.

tokens.name: edge
tokens.usage: Graph edges that are not highlighted.

tokens.name: tint-hover
tokens.usage: ink over a row on hover.

tokens.name: tint-accent
tokens.usage: accent behind an outlined primary button on hover; 0.22 when pressed.

tokens.name: disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled controls.

duration.note: Motion is functional. Each value is a CSS time.

tokens.name: duration-fast
tokens.usage: Hover fills.

tokens.name: duration-base
tokens.usage: Tab and chevron changes.

tokens.name: duration-rise
tokens.usage: The sidecar, dock, dialog and toast entering.

tokens.name: duration-meter
tokens.usage: A meter or progress bar changing width.

tokens.name: duration-pulse
tokens.usage: One cycle of the running glow. Stop it when prefers-reduced-motion is set.

layer.note: Stack order, low to high. Use these z-index values only.

tokens.name: layer-canvas
tokens.usage: The graph canvas and its nodes.

tokens.name: layer-toolbar
tokens.usage: The canvas toolbar and the sticky read-only bar in a review.

tokens.name: layer-sidecar
tokens.usage: The sidecar and the coordinator dock.

tokens.name: layer-dialog
tokens.usage: A dialog and its backdrop; a popped-out review.

tokens.name: layer-toast
tokens.usage: The toast stack, above everything.
